_source: Catalogue row of the construction register (docs/design/v5.3-c-register.md). capacity, per nation, in the stock's own unit (beds) = the mean beds of the nation's general full-service hospitals, not of every establishment: Germany 290 = the 420 922 set-up beds of the 1 452 Allgemeine Krankenhaeuser (Destatis, Grunddaten der Krankenhaeuser - Bundeslaender, table 23111-b14, 2025). France 313 = 190 034 medicine, surgery and obstetrics beds in full hospitalisation of the 13 mainland regions (DREES, Base ARES, MCO_LIT, 2021) over the 607 establishments with an authorised emergency department (NB_URG, 2021), as the full-service proxy; closure rules read capacity, never unit counts (D3). STAND-IN numbers, none sourced: every figure marked below is the game's declared placeholder until the author's table of stand-ins (spec section 12). cost_eur_m: stand-in of 0.40 M EUR per bed (125.2 M EUR for the 313-bed unit), taken as about 3 300 EUR per square metre (the middle of the 2 800 to 3 900 EUR a square metre that the Baden-Wuerttemberg Rechnungshof compared for two children's clinics) times an assumed 120 square metres a bed; no per-bed audit figure was found in a bounded search. running_eur_m: stand-in of 0.26 M EUR per bed a year (81.4 M EUR for the unit). staff: stand-in of 3 jobs a bed (939). build_months, overrun_odds, overrun_share, demolish_months, demolish_cost_share, band_units: the spec's stand-ins (sections 5, 7, 12) with a longer build for a hospital. figure_elasticity: +1 by the spec (more beds, more beds per 1 000). bloc_offset_per_pop_share: stand-in. DEU: the same 0.40 M EUR per bed and 0.26 M EUR per bed a year as FRA applied to its 290-bed unit (116.0 and 75.4 M EUR); a bounded search found no German per-bed audit figure. GBR: capacity 693 = the mean beds of the English NHS trusts that report general and acute beds (a trust runs several hospitals; no table gives hospitals; data/units/stock/GBR.json), the same 0.40 M EUR per bed and 0.26 M EUR per bed a year as FRA applied to the 693-bed unit (277.2 and 180.2 M EUR); no British per-bed cost figure was found in a bounded search. POL: capacity 176 = the mean beds of a Polish general hospital (data/units/stock/POL.json), the same 0.40 M EUR per bed and 0.26 M EUR per bed a year as FRA applied to that unit (70.4 and 45.8 M EUR); a bounded search of the Supreme Audit Office (NIK) reports found no per-bed cost to read.
name: Hospital
summary: A hospital with its beds, open all year round.
